heading: Presumption as to powers-of-attorney.
text: The Court shall presume that every document purporting to be a power-of-attorney, and to have been executed before, and authenticated by, a Notary Public, or any Court, Judge, Magistrate, [1][Indian] Consul or Vice-Consul, or representative [2]*** of the [3][Central Government], was so executed and authenticated.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: The Words “of Her Majesty, or” Rep. by ibid.
Subs. by the A.O. 1937, for “Government of India”.
